tasks.title: Matching Shoe Brand
tasks.text: Find a runner wearing the same shoe brand as you. Take a photo showing both pairs.

tasks.title: 10-Runner Selfie
tasks.text: Take a group selfie with 10 other runners.

tasks.title: Finish Line Photo
tasks.text: Take a photo with the Dubai Run finish sign visible.

tasks.title: Dubai Run Bib Selfie
tasks.text: Take a selfie with your own Dubai Run bib visible.

tasks.title: Matching Colours
tasks.text: Find a runner wearing the same shoe colour as you. Take a photo showing both pairs.

tasks.title: Reverse Bibs
tasks.text: Find a runner whose bib ends with your last two digits reversed, like 27 and 72. Take a selfie showing both bib endings.

tasks.title: Dubai Run Throwback
tasks.text: Find someone wearing an older Dubai Run shirt. Take a photo showing both editions. Bonus if you get three different years in one photo.

tasks.title: Three Emirates
tasks.text: Find runners who came from three different Emirates. Take a group selfie and name all three Emirates in the caption.

tasks.title: The 1–5 Bib Lineup
tasks.text: Find five runners whose bibs end in 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5. Take one group photo showing all five endings.

tasks.title: Recreate the Run
tasks.text: Find someone with a photo from a previous Dubai Run. Recreate their old pose together and upload the two shots side by side.

tasks.title: Triple 7
tasks.text: Find someone whose bib contains three 7s anywhere in the number. Take a selfie with them holding up seven fingers.

tasks.title: Three Running Crews
tasks.text: Take one photo with runners from three different running groups. Name the groups in your caption.

tasks.title: Dubai Then and Now
tasks.text: Recreate a pose from an older Dubai Run photo with the same Dubai landmark in the background. Submit the photos side by side.

tasks.title: The Skyline Lineup
tasks.text: Take a group photo with five other runners and two recognizable Dubai landmarks in the same frame.

tasks.title: Four Shoe Brands
tasks.text: Find four runners wearing four different shoe brands. Take one photo showing all four pairs.

tasks.title: Best Photography Award · 4 points
tasks.text: Submit any photo related to Dubai Run. The winning photo earns 4 points.

tasks.title: Best Selfie · 4 points
tasks.text: Take a selfie with something related to Dubai Run. The winning selfie earns 4 points.

tasks.title: Most Calories Burned
tasks.text: Upload a screenshot or other proof showing your total calories burned on Dubai Run day.
